name: Mikami Amane
source:
A 2nd year student at Marenis High School.
She had been living abroad until last month, but she returned to Marenis where she had lived during her childhood.
She has a positive and dependable personality, capable of saying that what's wrong is wrong.
She likes the laidback-looking character "Yusshi of Lake Yus."

"I'm happy to prepare for the Marenis Festival together with everyone in the children's association again!"

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=0]official website[/url]]
